description: Create trigger/<name>.trigger.mcs.yml pointing at a cloud flow that starts the agent (WorkflowExternalTrigger). The first call changes nothing: it returns the files it would write, as a diff against what is there now, for the user to approve. Call it again with the same arguments plus confirm: true to write them.

confirm.description: Required to write the change to the file. Without it the tool returns a preview - the changed lines against the current ones, and the character count - and writes nothing.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_add_trigger
title: Add an event trigger
